transcript.sitrep:
=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make decisions on a tiny biased sample; we need real data on spread and severity immediately.

actions.rationale: We cannot make decisions on a tiny biased sample; we need real data on spread and severity immediately.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions buys time to assess the threat while protecting Americans at the border.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions buys time to assess the threat while protecting Americans at the border.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Straight, data-driven briefings from me build public trust and prevent panic or misinformation from filling the vacuum.

actions.rationale: Straight, data-driven briefings from me build public trust and prevent panic or misinformation from filling the vacuum.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and citizens the real-time information they need to act locally.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and citizens the real-time information they need to act locally.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We need emergency funding and statutory authority lined up now so we are not caught flat-footed if this worsens.

actions.rationale: We need emergency funding and statutory authority lined up now so we are not caught flat-footed if this worsens.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Early targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk is the proportional response that saves lives without needlessly shuttering the economy on incomplete data.

actions.rationale: Early targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk is the proportional response that saves lives without needlessly shuttering the economy on incomplete data.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.
